a_features: segarecomp_xplat_models.a_features (210 columns: 59 token-value counts, chain max/mean/long, targets out/in, zero/ASCII fraction, entropy, relocation fields, seed flag, PROVEN-reach count; then the +/-1 and +/-4 neighbour means)
condition_rule: models A/B/C train on C2 unless the T004 overall class is TRANSFER_HARMS (then C0); same genesis_lolo and xplat_lolo folds as T004; no hyper-parameter search (fixed configurations below) - nothing is tuned on the folds compared

disclosures.label_gated_xplat_seeds: cross-platform seeds exist only where the T002 listing labels the container entry as an instruction start (BattleIsleEditor 6/12, HelloAmi 3/4, EmuTOS 1/4 samples have none); the seed flag and the PROVEN-reach root are therefore label-gated on cross-platform images (Genesis seeds come from the product's label-free discovery); xplat_lolo results carry this caveat; inherited from the frozen T003 corpus and shared with the T004 baselines
disclosures.proven_semantics: PROVEN reachability follows fall-through past calls and traps (only direct jumps, dynamic jumps and returns stop fall-through): more permissive than the product's conservative discovery; it is a model input flag, never execution authority
disclosures.relocation_feature: relocation-field counts come from container metadata (available at inference on those platforms; 0 on Genesis): platform-correlated, kept as pre-registered; a no-relocation ablation would be exploratory only

enforcement: fit refuses unless this addendum's digests equal the current files and the plan; each fit record carries the addendum digest and table ignores nothing unstamped (an unstamped / foreign-stamped score refuses); B and C fits require a committed T005 results document under this addendum showing their gate open (A complete); closed-gate models never enter selection; no A/B/C fit was run before this addendum was committed. Procedural limit: importing segarecomp_xplat_models directly cannot be prevented in code; such fits are never stamped and are refused by table

gates.B: built only if decide.select over {M1_HGB, A, M3_R, M4_DENSE@128, M4_DENSE@64} returns a configuration with genesis mean ER >= 0.10 (decide.b_gate) AND T004 is not EVIDENCE_INSUFFICIENT: a bounded local instruction-aware Transformer: per-word input = embed(hi byte) + embed(lo byte) + the M3/M4 decode-token embeddings, d_model 64, 2 encoder layers, 4 heads, feed-forward 128, learned positions, attention restricted to non-overlapping 256-word windows with 64 words of real context (or PAD) on each side; per-word logit -> cell max (M4 aggregation); training exactly M4's budget and recipe (4000 steps, batch 8, AdamW lr 0.002 x0.1 after 80%, weight decay 1e-4, masked BCE with M4's pos_weight, lineage-uniform sampling, seeds 1-3 averaged)
gates.C: built only if B is better than A by the ordering with genesis mean ER lower by >= tau: B plus 2 rounds of typed sparse message passing per encoder layer over edges within the window+context: fall-through (ordinary decode -> next position by decoder length), direct branch / call target (computed as for A), overlapping interpretation (positions inside a decoded instruction's extent), each typed separately as CANDIDATE edges, plus a node flag for positions statically reachable from seed roots by fall-through and direct edges (PROVEN); hypothetical edges never mark a position reachable; same training budget as B

pre_fit_deviations.chain_feature: 'number of chain starts' (equal to the ordinary-decode count, already in the status counts) is replaced by the mean chain length and the count of chains >= 8
pre_fit_deviations.control_targets: candidate direct targets = Bcc/BRA/BSR (8/16-bit displacement), DBcc, JMP/JSR (d16,PC), and JMP/JSR absolute .W/.L interpreted as an image offset when inside the image; exact on Genesis cartridges (address = file offset); on relocatable Atari/Amiga images the stored absolute operand is section-relative, so it is exact for intra-section targets only; the same targets feed C's direct edges and the PROVEN search
